Up to a maximum of 3 years for OBC candidates where posts are reserved.
10 years for PwBD candidates (whether post is reserved or not), 13 years for PwBD (OBC) where vacancies are reserved, and 15 years for PwBD (SC/ST) where vacancies are reserved.
5 years for Ex-servicemen as per rules.

pfrda-officer-grade-a-assistant-manager-.exam_date: Phase I: October 15, 2026 (Thursday); Phase II: November 20, 2026 (Friday)
selection_process: Phase I: On-line Screening examination consisting of two papers of 100 marks each.
Phase II: On-line examination consisting of two papers of 100 marks each.
Phase III: Interview.
exam_pattern: Phase I - Paper 1 (All Streams - 90 Questions, 100 Marks, 60 minutes): English Language (20 Q / 25 Marks), Quantitative Aptitude (20 Q / 25 Marks), Test of Reasoning (30 Q / 25 Marks), General Awareness including Financial Sector (20 Q / 25 Marks).

Phase I - Paper 2 (General Stream - 50 Questions, 100 Marks, 40 minutes): Commerce, Accountancy, Management, Finance, Costing, Companies Act, Economics and Pension Sector, Artificial Intelligence (AI), Media, Marketing & Communication.
Phase I - Paper 2 (Research, Actuary and Official Language Streams - 50 Questions, 100 Marks, 40 minutes): Specialized subject related to stream.
Phase II - Paper 1 (All Streams - 3 Questions, 100 Marks, 60 minutes, 1/3rd weightage): English (Descriptive Test) to test drafting skills.

Phase II - Paper 2 (General Stream - 50 Questions, 100 Marks, 40 minutes, 2/3rd weightage): Commerce, Accountancy, Management, Finance, Costing, Companies Act, Economics and Pension Sector, AI, Media, Marketing & Communication.
Phase II - Paper 2 (Research, Actuary and Official Language Streams - 50 Questions, 100 Marks, 40 minutes, 2/3rd weightage): Multiple choice questions on Specialized subject related to stream.
syllabus: Paper 2 General Stream: PFRDA Act 2013, Union Budget & Economic Survey, Commerce & Accountancy, Management, Finance, Costing, Companies Act, Economics, Pension Sector, Artificial Intelligence (AI)/ Machine Learning (ML), Media, Marketing & Communication.

Research Stream: Probability Theory, Descriptive Statistics, Probability Distributions, Statistical Inference, Sampling Techniques, Testing of Hypothesis, Economic Statistics, Time Series Analysis, Operations Research, Statistical Quality Control, Statistical computing.

Official Language (Rajbhasha) Stream: Bharat Sarkar ki Rajbhasha Niti, Hindi se Angrezi anuvad, Angrezi se Hindi anuvad, Vidhik Shabdavali, Pension/Administrative/Banking/Capital Market/Economics/Social Security Terminology.
Actuarial Stream: Insurance and Management (History of Indian insurance, principles, risk, legal foundations, products, valuation, solvency, and Management topics).
documents_required: Passport size photograph (4.5cm x 3.5cm)
Scanned signature (not in CAPITAL LETTERS)
Left thumb impression (or right thumb if left not available)
Handwriting declaration in English
Valid photo identity proof (PAN Card/Passport/Driving License/Voter's Card/Aadhaar/etc.)
Caste/Income and Asset/Disability certificates where applicable
pfrda-officer-grade-a-assistant-manager-.salary_pay_scale: Rs. 62500-3600(4)-76900-4050(7)-105250-EB-4050(4)-121450-4650(1)-126100 (17 years). Gross emoluments at minimum of scale approx. Rs. 2,05,000/- per month.

Separate online application and requisite fee must be submitted for each stream.
No change or correction in the application form will be entertained after final submission.
